worker_claim.report: Systemd reconciliation now separates stable ownership proof from deployment representation, preserves authoritative unit names, and avoids rewriting already-current units. Host startup safely reconstructs a missing systemd installation record while rejecting an existing non-systemd policy.
worker_claim.summary: Implemented explicit systemd unit ownership classification and bidirectional reconciliation. Owned units with stale launcher, binding, or other deployment-render details are atomically refreshed in place, while foreign or ambiguous units remain fail-closed; missing host installation metadata is adopted after successful systemd startup when no conflicting policy exists. Added regressions for launcher replacement, downgrade symmetry, idempotent reconciliation, and foreign-unit protection.
